title: Open Quadruped
summary: Four-legged walking robot by Adham Elarabawy with a 3S battery, power distribution and 5 V regulation, gait controller, IMU, and a 12-channel hub that powers and commands three servos per leg.

assemblySteps.title: Build the chassis and tray
assemblySteps.summary: Seat the rails and shoulder frames in the lower shell. Fit the electronics tray between the rails.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the front left leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the bridge and both leg links. Install the three servos and attach the foot.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the front right leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the bridge and both leg links. Install the three servos and attach the foot.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the rear left leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the bridge and both leg links. Install the three servos and attach the foot.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the rear right leg
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the hip at the shoulder and fit the bridge and both leg links. Install the three servos and attach the foot.

assemblySteps.title: Mount the battery and electronics
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the power board, gait controller, IMU, and servo hub on the tray. Seat the battery holder against the right rail and secure it with a strap clamp.

assemblySteps.title: Connect the power leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the battery to the BEC, then connect the BEC outputs to the hub and gait controller.

assemblySteps.title: Connect the controller data leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the controller to the servo hub over USB and to the IMU over the sensor bus.

assemblySteps.title: Connect the front left servo leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the three front left servos to hub channels 7, 8, 9.

assemblySteps.title: Connect the front right servo leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the three front right servos to hub channels 10, 11, 12.

assemblySteps.title: Connect the rear left servo leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the three rear left servos to hub channels 1, 2, 3.

assemblySteps.title: Connect the rear right servo leads
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the three rear right servos to hub channels 5, 4, 6.
